text.A: **Esta política se aplica dondequiera que se encuentre.** Cumplimos la legislación de protección de datos del Reino Unido y, cuando también se aplique la legislación de protección de datos del país en el que vive, cumplimos también esta.
text.B: **Notas sobre alergias y dietas.** Se las transmitimos al food truck junto con su pedido y no las utilizamos para nada más. Las eliminamos, junto con su nombre y sus datos de contacto, 12 meses después del pedido (véase la sección 7).
text.C: **Transferencias internacionales.** Los datos de su cuenta y los datos de los pedidos se almacenan y se tratan en el Reino Unido. Algunas operaciones se realizan fuera de él: la extracción de cartas y las respuestas automáticas de WhatsApp, que utilizan un servicio de Google en Estados Unidos; la entrega de mensajes de WhatsApp, que realiza Meta en Estados Unidos; los pagos, que gestiona Stripe en Estados Unidos; y las notificaciones push, que entregan Apple y Google en Estados Unidos. Cuando los datos salen del Reino Unido, la transferencia está amparada por la normativa de adecuación del Reino Unido o por el International Data Transfer Agreement (Acuerdo Internacional de Transferencia de Datos) o el Addendum (Adenda) y, cuando la legislación de su país lo exija, por una garantía reconocida por dicha legislación. Puede solicitarnos información sobre las garantías aplicables.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with the data protection legislation of the United Kingdom and, where the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Notes on allergies and diets.** We pass them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for anything else. We delete them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: Where the data leaves the United Kingdom, the transfer is covered by the UK adequacy regulations or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or the Addendum and, where the legislation of your country requires it, by a safeguard recognised by that legislation.
back.D:
## 8. Your rights

Under the data protection legislation of the United Kingdom and, where applicable, the legislation of the country you live in, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged]

The legislation of the country you live in may recognise these rights for you under other names, or additional rights. You have those rights too.

**How to make a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We will check that the request is genuine before dealing with it. You can ask another person to make the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently for making it. We will reply within one month, or sooner if the legislation of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because it is the one that decides how your order data is used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to examine it again by replying to our answer.

**Deleting your account.** [unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also delete its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep.

**Commercial emails.** We send commercial emails only where the legislation of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each of them says who sends it, includes our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop sending them, we will, at no cost and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not commercial communications. If we or a food truck offer order updates by text message, you will only receive them if you agree to receive them, and you can stop them at any time.

**If something goes wrong.** If a security breach affecting your personal data could cause you serious harm, we will tell you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible where the law requires it, or we will help the food truck you ordered from to do so.

**Complaints.** Tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would appreciate the chance to sort it out. You can also complain to the data protection authority of the country you live in. In the United Kingdom, it is the Information Commissioner's Office (the UK data protection authority), at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.
